title: a frozen plan never launches its contract
proves: faberun plan, driven end to end through src/cli.mjs with a --runtimes catalogue on the replay harness, freezes a plan (writes plan.json with status frozen and a contract.json alongside it) without ever launching that contract: no .runs/<contract id>/ run directory is created for the frozen contract's own id. The draft and the (clean) review are each an ordinary run the pipeline itself launches and waits on; freezing is a pure write that follows.
